rows.coder_note: FinnGen is cited to Kurki 2023 (entries 35, 40), the source of every FinnGen release row; the sentence gives no release number and its endpoint counts (648 or 1249 cases with 259,583 controls; 84 with 259,584) equal no release N, so no attribute separates the rows (rule E not met).

Gallbladder cancer data 'from the UK Biobank' (195 cases, 456,134 controls) cite entry 38 (Jiang 2021), whose DOI is no dictionary row's source; no release, accession or pipeline is given in the sentence, so the entry cannot carry a code.
